```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

This is a short hands-on demonstration of the `fjoin_*()` family of functions.

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(fjoin)
```

Please also see:

- [Package Overview](../doc/fjoin-overview.html): a more extended description of the package and how it works.
- [Performance Checks](../doc/fjoin-performance.html): a simple benchmark against common alternatives.

```{r}
dt1 <- data.table(id=1:3, v1=letters[1:3])
dt2 <- data.table(id=4:2, v2=LETTERS[4:2])
```

```{r}
fjoin_left(dt1, dt2, indicate = TRUE)
```
